changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser: a Rust-based, headless browser CLI for fast, structured web automation with Node.js fallback.

- Supports navigation, clicking, typing, form filling, and page snapshotting via simple commands.
- Offers structured outputs (refs) for interactive elements to streamline automated workflows.
- Includes commands for screenshots, PDFs, video recording, mouse/keyboard interaction, semantic locators, and more.
- Features session management, storage/cookie operations, network request routing, and multi-tab/window control.
- Installation available via npm or from source; quick start and full command reference provided in documentation.
